_comment: The squaring shear's build (SquaringShear/README.md, 'Build order'): each stage after the frame and its materials, as its rig's parts draw them; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema) and kept by the shared machine base (docs/modeling/machine-base.md). One item a stage: the blades an iron or steel plate (drawn in that metal), the back gauge and hold-down an iron, meteoric iron or steel rod (drawn in that metal). A hand machine: nothing wears. No block: the shear's construction record is its own in the recipe export, not the ore machines' generic one.
